title: SwitchCoal + Earth Observation: Janschwalde
switchcoal_assumption: Coal generation could be replaced by a nearby renewable mix within roughly a 100 x 100 km search area while reusing or building on existing energy infrastructure.

tee.role: Detailed plant-footprint embedding exploration, not full-region suitability modelling.

resource_stack.solar: PVGIS v5_3 PVcalc sampled on a 5 x 5 grid
resource_stack.wind: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API / ERA5 2023 daily 100 m mean wind speed
resource_stack.water_storage: WorldCover water/open/built surface context and water proximity

interpretation: The first pass points toward a selective hybrid replacement logic: a large low/constrained share, with solar, wind, mixed solar-wind, and storage-context pockets that deserve closer screening.
caveat: This is a first-pass evidence stack. It is not a permitting, grid-capacity, land-ownership, turbine-setback, financial, or investment model. OpenStreetMap grid/water/protected context overlays were unavailable in the current build.
